newsitem.title: USA: Helm Resources to sell Interpak Terminals.
newsitem.headline: Helm Resources to sell Interpak Terminals.

text.p: Helm Resources inc said Wednesday that a subsidiary had reached an agreement in principle to sell its Interpak Terminals operations to InterSystems Inc.

The subsidiary, Interpak Holdings Inc, is to sell the operations for an undisclosed price consisting of the assumption by InterSystems of certain Helm debentures, a cash down payment and a short-term promissory note that may be paid in cash or common stock, it said.
This pending sale comes after a previously announced letter of intent to sell Interpak to an investment group led by Fred Zeidman, president of Interpak Holdings, was terminated.

"The sale of Interpak will essentially complete Helm's corporate restructuring, which will enable our company to focus on and grow our interests in highly profitable financial services for small- and medium-sized businesses," Helm Chairman Herbert Pearlman said in a statement.
Interpak provides custom-packaging and distribution services to manufacturers of thermoplastic resins.
